annotator: Labelhand build (Claude, for Stephen Sookra), read directly from the EPA label text extracted by tools/ppls_fetch.py; not derived from model output. The 228-653 and 228-659 clauses were written before any compiled output for those labels existed. The 5481-504 clauses are carried over unchanged from v0.
review_status: not yet reviewed by an outside expert; labelled as our own annotation until it is
scope: clauses the spray-window planner uses: wind, temperature inversion, rain, air and night temperature, open-boll stage, buffers, release or nozzle height, droplet size, re-entry interval. Rate tables, first aid, storage, mixing order and aerial boom geometry are out of scope. Cotton directions only: the tobacco section of 228-659 is out of scope, and so are its rate-table rows (the temperature bands there choose a rate, not a window).
matching: a compiled rule matches a gold clause when the whitespace-free, lowercased gold key is contained in the whitespace-free, lowercased rule quote (or the reverse)
replaces: v0 scored the development tank (Folex 6 EC, Dropp SC, Prep). Dropp SC 264-700 is cancelled at EPA and Prep 264-418 has no Georgia registration record, so v1 scores the shipped tank: Folex 6 EC, FreeFall SC, Super Boll.
